notes: The page gives two formulations of the Hodge data associated with a place, a scalar extension and a filtered space. The first formulation explicitly writes Hξ(W)^(p), with W, although the opening module is V; the ink is retained and no V is substituted. The upper weight note reads p and −2, with the word norme still uncertain and the article le unchanged. The second opening has C-module, as shown by the doubled left stroke shared with the C field letters. The real-place paragraph names frobξ, then its primed semilinear extension, and asks for identity on Hξ(V); the written “½-linéaire” is preserved. The overwritten initial G exponent is not settled from the later G⁰ occurrences. The margin field diagram has final index ∞. These are reports of the page, without an independent proof of the constructions or compatibility claim. Archive number 164.
doubts: Tall initial loop favours l’on, central letters crossed.
Earlier looped sign is heavily overwritten.
Several loops beneath a thick strike.
notation: W occurs once visibly; parentheses vary as written.
Prime and numerical half are visible.
Inserted upper field has a wave, lower display has a straight bar.
hand: The C field letter has a doubled vertical stroke inside a broad open curve. This supports C at the lower module opening, against C’s G|C and H’s E. Other G letters on the page have their separate inward/lower spur.
The overwritten superscript on the opening G remains uncertain despite clear later G⁰ forms. A repeated mathematical role does not restore covered strokes.
